```{r}
source("./pipe.R")
input = pipeline$cpdb_analysis_per_patient$input
output = pipeline$cpdb_analysis_per_patient$output
```

```{r}
acc_cancer_Tcells_caf = readRDS(input$acc_cancer_Tcells_caf)

```


```{r}
all_pvals = list()
all_means = list()
for (patient in c("ACC22", "ACC15", "ACC7",  "ACC5")) {
  seurat_data = dirname(input$create_data_report) %s+% "/cells_seurat_" %s+% patient %s+% ".RDS"
  pvals = dirname(input$run_cpdb_per_patient_report) %s+% "/cpdb_out/statistical_analysis_pvalues_" %s+% patient %s+% ".txt"
  means = dirname(input$run_cpdb_per_patient_report) %s+% "/cpdb_out/statistical_analysis_means_" %s+% patient %s+% ".txt"
  all_pvals[[patient]] = fread(pvals)
  all_means[[patient]] = fread(means)
}
```

```{r}
all_cols_list = list()
all_rows_list = list()
all_positive_indexes =list()
for (patient in names(all_pvals)) {
  just_pvals = all_pvals[[patient]][,12:ncol(all_pvals[[patient]])] %>% as.matrix()
  rownames(just_pvals) = all_pvals[[patient]]$id_cp_interaction
  colnames(just_pvals) = colnames(all_pvals[[patient]][,12:ncol(all_pvals[[patient]])])
  
  
  results = just_pvals < 0.05 
  positive_indexes = which(results,arr.ind = TRUE) %>% as.data.frame()
  all_positive_indexes[[patient]] = paste(rownames(results)[positive_indexes$row], colnames(results)[positive_indexes$col],sep = "~")


}


all_positive_common_indexes = Reduce(intersect, all_positive_indexes)
SplitCoords <- strsplit(all_positive_common_indexes, split = "~")
all_common_cols = unique(sapply(SplitCoords, `[`, 2))
all_common_pairs = unique(sapply(SplitCoords, `[`, 1))

all_common_pvals = matrix(1, nrow = length(all_common_pairs), ncol = length(all_common_cols),
                          dimnames = list(all_common_pairs, all_common_cols)) %>% as.data.frame()

for (interaction in SplitCoords) {
    all_common_pvals[interaction[1],interaction[2]] <- 0.01
}
all_common_pvals$id_cp_interaction = rownames(all_common_pvals)

FilteredList <- map(all_means, ~{
  .x %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    filter(id_cp_interaction %in% all_common_pairs) %>% 
    select(all_common_cols)
})

TotalMatrix_Filtered <- Reduce(`+`, FilteredList)
AverageMatrix_Filtered <- TotalMatrix_Filtered / length(all_means)
AverageMatrix_Filtered$id_cp_interaction = all_common_pairs

```

```{r}
AverageMatrix_Filtered = right_join(all_means[[1]][,1:11],AverageMatrix_Filtered,by = "id_cp_interaction") %>% as.data.frame()
all_common_pvals = right_join(all_means[[1]][,1:11],all_common_pvals,by = "id_cp_interaction") %>% as.data.frame()

```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
my_plot_cpdb(cell_type1 = 'CD|Treg|gdT', cell_type2 = 'Luminal pri|Myo pri', scdata = acc_cancer_Tcells_caf,
                      idents = 'cell_type', means = AverageMatrix_Filtered, pvals = all_common_pvals,
                      gene.family = NULL,return_table = F,max_size = 3,p.adjust.method = "fdr",
                      keep_significant_only = T,cluster_rows = T)
```
